topics.description: The Minnesota child care fraud scandal is trending due to its significant impact on low-income families and the large amount of federal funds involved.
topics.reason: The Trump administration's freeze on $185M in child care funds for Minnesota has sparked controversy and concern among state officials and residents.

topics.description: The FBI's investigation into the ICE shooting in Minnesota is trending due to concerns over the handling of the case and potential misconduct by law enforcement.
topics.reason: The shooting has sparked tensions between state and federal authorities, with some questioning the FBI's involvement.
